en: A black‑and‑white postcard view taken from under a stone arch, likely a bridge, looking along a shallow rocky river. On the right side stand old, overhanging traditional houses with white facades, wooden beams, and many windows, built directly on a tall stone wall lining the riverbank. The setting appears to be a historic Balkan town. In the top left corner there is printed text in Cyrillic.
